_about: The 84 establishment codes with "Reports to EDDC" = Y in the WA Health Establishment List, May 2026 v0.1 (official code, name, Est type, MPS). HSP, region, district, beds and coordinates are NOT in that List: they are joined from SLIP / OpenStreetMap and labelled by hspBasis and locationStatus. See docs/ESTABLISHMENTS.md.
_attribution: © Government of Western Australia, Department of Health (Establishment List, May 2026; SLIP / data.wa.gov.au HEALTH-001). OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) for the coordinate marked osm-similar-name.

establishments.name: Perth Children's Hospital
establishments.hspNote: Perth Children's Hospital is part of CAHS (SLIP lists it under the North Metro geographic service).

establishments.name: WA Virtual Hospital
establishments.locationNote: WA Virtual Hospital: a virtual service (WA Virtual Emergency Department, WAVED) with no physical emergency department. Not in SLIP. Shown at a placeholder point in the Perth CBD.
establishments.hspNote: WAVED is described in the WACHS 2025-26 Service Agreement (s 3.1.1), with its functions performed by the Department CEO through the State Health Operations Centre (SHOC) during a transfer period. Shown under WACHS as a display grouping only.

establishments.name: Peel Health Campus
establishments.locationNote: SLIP lists this site as estab_id 645 "Peel Health Campus".
establishments.hspNote: Peel Health Campus returned to public operation (SMHS) on 13 Aug 2024. The Establishment List has Peel under both 0145 and 0645 with Reports to EDDC = Y; SLIP uses 645.

establishments.name: Joondalup Health Campus
establishments.hspNote: Joondalup Health Campus: public services operated by Ramsay Health Care under a public-private arrangement; NMHS catchment.

establishments.name: Peel Health Campus
establishments.hspNote: Second Peel Health Campus code. In the List 0645 reports to EDDC, MHDC and SANADC only, and is not in the Hospital Morbidity System Codes table. Assumed to be the same physical site as 0145 (not verified).

establishments.name: Jurien Bay Hospital
establishments.locationNote: Not in SLIP. OpenStreetMap has "Jurien Bay Health Centre", 23 Whitfield Road, Jurien Bay, but no "Jurien Bay Hospital"; assumed to be the same site (not verified). District and region by point-in-polygon on the SLIP HEALTH-002 boundaries.
establishments.hspNote: HSP not stated in the documents; Jurien Bay is in a WA Country Health Service area; display grouping.

establishments.name: St John of God Midland Health Campus
establishments.slipName: St John of God Midland Hospital
establishments.hspNote: St John of God Midland Public Hospital: operated by St John of God Health Care under a public-private arrangement; EMHS catchment. Uses Midland webPAS (EDDC Data Dictionary, abbreviations SJOGM).
